examples.english: Then he will send out his angels, and will gather together his chosen ones from the four winds, from the ends of the earth to the ends of the sky.

examples.english: From those who did violence to them, from the head of the land to the end of the world,

examples.english: And also we know that the good and compassionate God supports all of us from the start of the earth to the ends of the inhabited world,

examples.coptic: ⲉϥⲉⲉⲣϭⲟⲓⲥ ⲓⲥϫⲉⲛ ⲓⲟⲙ ϣⲁⲓⲟⲙ: ⲛⲉⲙⲓⲥϫⲉⲛ ⲫⲓⲁⲣⲟ ϣⲁ**ⲁⲩⲣⲏϫ**ⲥ ⲛϯⲟⲓⲕⲟⲩⲙⲉⲛⲏ .
examples.english: In his days shall righteousness spring up; and abundance of peace till the moon be removed.
